scenes.description: The player threads traffic at speed with three OCPD interceptors flanking and the tanker ahead, four wanted stars on the HUD.
scenes.title: Four-star chase — tanker escort under fire

scenes.title: On foot at the marina

scenes.title: Coast race — checkpoints and a rival

scenes.description: Three wanted stars on the pier as police cars block the shore and the player stands their ground at the pier end.
scenes.title: Pier shootout — OCPD closing in
